tool.name: Feat2traj
tool.description: Converts a .pt file (features) to a trajectory using cartesian indices and topology from the stats file.

param.name: input_results_npz_path
param.help: Path to the input reconstructed results file (.npz), typically containing an 'xhat' array

param.name: input_stats_pt_path
param.help: Path to the input model statistics file (.pt) containing cartesian indices and optionally topology

param.name: input_topology_path
param.help: Path to the topology file (PDB) used if no suitable topology is found in the stats file. Used if no topology is found in stats

param.name: outname_output_traj_path
param.help: Path to save the trajectory in xtc/pdb/dcd format

param.name: outname_output_top_path
param.help: Path to save the output topology file (pdb). Used if trajectory format requires separate topology

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
